_comment: TACTICAL-FLOW pack — coherent_tactical_pack from the game-feel/tactical audit (workflow w15jy8s51). All dt270 basePosition + pass fields, verified-live (proven readers) or high-confidence. Absolute targets; apply with --stack so it layers on loose-realism-v2 + rating formula. Reversible via gameplay_tune restore.
